verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ በመዋዕለ ፡ ይኴንኑ ፡ መሳፍንት ፡ መጽአ ፡ ረኃብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ወሖረ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቤተ
                  ፡ ልሔም ፡ ዘይሁዳ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንበር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐቅለ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ ወደቂቁ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land: and a man went from Bethleem Juda to sojourn in the land of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land: and a man went from Bethleem Juda to sojourn in the land of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
translations.ron: În zilele acelea, când cârmuiau în Israel judecătorii, s-a întâmplat foamete pe pământ. Atunci un om din Betleemul lui Iuda s-a dus cu femeia sa şi cu cei doi feciori ai săi să locuiască în şesul Moabiţilor.
translations.grk: ΚΑΙ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ κρίνειν τοὺς κριτὰς, καὶ ἐγένετο λιμὸς ἐν τῇ γῇ· καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἀνὴρ ἀπὸ Βηθλεὲμ Ἰούδα τοῦ παροικῆσαι ἐν ἀγρῷ Μωὰβ, αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οἱ δύο υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወስሙ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ አሊሜሌክ ፡ ወስመ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ ወአስማተ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ መሐሎን ፡
                  ወኬሌዎን ፡ ኤፍራታዊያን ፡ እምነ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ልሔም ፡ ዘይሁዳ ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐቅለ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ህየ ።
verses.translation: And the man's name was Elimelech, and his wife's name Noemin, and the names of his two sons Maalon and Chelaion, Ephrathites of Bethleem of Juda: and they came to the land of Moab, and remained there.

translations.lxx: And the man's name was Elimelech, and his wife's name Noemin, and the names of his two sons Maalon and Chelaion, Ephrathites of Bethleem of Juda: and they came to the land of Moab, and remained there.
translations.kjv: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.
translations.ron: Numele omului aceluia era Elimelec; pe femeia sa o chema Noemina, iar numele celor doi feciori ai lor erau Mahlon şi Chilion. Aceştia erau Efrateni din Betleemul lui Iuda şi, venind în şesul Moabiţilor, au rămas acolo.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὄνομα τῷ ἀνδρὶ Ἐλιμέλεχ, καὶ ὄνομα τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ Νωεμὶν, καὶ ὄνομα τοῖς δυσὶν υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ Μααλὼν, καὶ Χελαιὼν, Ἐφραθαῖοι ἐκ Βηθλεὲμ τῆς Ἰούδα· καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς ἀγρὸν Μωὰβ, καὶ ἦσαν ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ አሊሜሌክ ፡ ምታ ፡ ለኖሔሚን ፡ ወተርፈት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወደቂቃ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Elimelech the husband of Noemin died; and she was left, and her two sons.

translations.lxx: And Elimelech the husband of Noemin died; and she was left, and her two sons.
translations.kjv: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.
translations.ron: După un timp Elimelec, bărbatul Noeminei, a murit ea a rămas cu cei doi feciori ai săi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἐλιμέλεχ ὁ ἀνὴρ τῆς Νωεμὶν, καὶ κατελείφθη αὕτη καὶ οἱ δύο υἱοὶ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወነሥኡ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ አንስተ ፡ ሞአባውያተ ፡ ስማ ፡ ለአሐቲ ፡ ዖርፋ ፡ ወስመ ፡ ካልእታ ፡ ሩት ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ህየ ፡
                  የአክል ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And they took to themselves wives, women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpha, and the name of the second Ruth; and they dwelt there about ten years.

translations.lxx: And they took to themselves wives, women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpha, and the name of the second Ruth; and they dwelt there about ten years.
translations.kjv: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.
translations.ron: Aceştia şi-au luat soţii dintre moabitence: numele uneia era Orfa, iar numele celeilalte era Rut. Aceştia au trăit acolo ca la zece ani.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάβοσαν ἑαυτοῖς γυναῖκας Μωαβίτιδας· ὄνομα τῇ μιᾷ, Ὀρφά· καὶ ὄνομα τῇ δευτέρᾳ, Ῥούθ· καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ ὡς δέκα ἔτη.

verses.geez:
ወሞቱ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ መሐሎን ፡ ወኬሌዎን ፡ ወተርፈት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ እምነ ፡ ምታ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ደቂቃ
                  ።
verses.translation: And both Maalon and Chelaion died also; and the woman was left of her husband and her two sons.

translations.lxx: And both Maalon and Chelaion died also; and the woman was left of her husband and her two sons.
translations.kjv: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.
translations.ron: După aceea au murit amândoi feciorii ei, Mahlon şi Chilion şi a rămas femeia aceea şi fără bărbatul său şi fără cei doi feciori ai săi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανον καί γε ἀμφότεροι Μααλὼν καὶ Χελαιών· καὶ κατελείφθη ἡ γυνὴ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν δύο υἱῶν αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወተንሥአት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወክልኤሆን ፡ መራዕዊሃ ፡ ወተመይጣ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሐቅለ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ እስመ ፡ [ሰምዐት ፡ ከመ ፡]
                  ተሣሀሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀቦሙ ፡ እክለ ።
verses.translation: And she rose up and her two daughters-in-law, and they returned out of the country of Moab, for she heard in the country of Moab that the Lord had visited his people to give them bread.

translations.lxx: And she rose up and her two daughters-in-law, and they returned out of the country of Moab, for she heard in the country of Moab that the Lord had visited his people to give them bread.
translations.kjv: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a hotărât ea cu nurorile sale să se întoarcă din şesul Moabiţilor, căci auzise ea în şesul Moabiţilor că Dumnezeu a cercetat pe poporul Său şi i-a dat pâine.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνεστη αὕτη καὶ αἱ δύο νύμφαι αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν ἐξ ἀγροῦ Μωὰβ, ὅτι ἤκουσεν ἐν ἀγρῷ Μωὰβ ὅτι ἐπέσκεπται Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, δοῦναι αὐτοῖς ἄρτους.

verses.geez:
ወወፅኣ ፡ እምነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይነብራ ፡ ወክልኤሆን ፡ መራዕዊሃ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወሖራ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖት ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ይእትዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ይሁዳ ።
verses.translation: And she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her: and they went by the way to return to the land of Juda.

translations.lxx: And she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her: and they went by the way to return to the land of Juda.
translations.kjv: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.
translations.ron: Deci a plecat ea din locul acela în care trăia, împreună cu cele două nurori ale sale. Dar mergând ele pe cale, pentru a se întoarce în pământul lui Iuda,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ τόπου οὗ ἦν ἐκεῖ, καὶ αἱ δύο νύμφαι αὐτῆς μετʼ αὐτῆς· καὶ ἐπορεύοντο ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι εἰς τὴν γῆν Ἰούδα.

verses.geez:
ወትቤሎን ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ ለመራዕዊሃ ፡ ሑራ ፡ እትዋ ፡ አብያተ ፡ እማቲክን ፡ ወይግበር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌክን ፡
                  ምሕረቶ ፡ ከመ ፡ ገበርክን ፡ ምስለ ፡ እለ ፡ ሞቱ ፡ ወምስሌየ ።
verses.translation: And Noemin said to her daughters-in-law, Go now, return each to the house of her mother: the Lord deal mercifully with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

translations.lxx: And Noemin said to her daughters-in-law, Go now, return each to the house of her mother: the Lord deal mercifully with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
translations.kjv: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
translations.ron: Noemina a zis către cele două nurori ale sale: "Întoarceţi-vă şi vă duceţi fiecare la casa mamei voastre; şi să facă Domnul milă cu voi, cum aţi făcut şi voi cu cei morţi şi cu mine!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Νωεμὶν, ταῖς δυσὶ νύμφαις αὐτῆς, πορεύεσθε δὴ, ἀποστράφητε ἑκάστη εἰς οἶκον μητρὸς αὐτῆς· ποιήσαι Κύριος μεθʼ ὑμῶν ἔλεος, καθὼς ἐποιήσατε μετὰ τῶν τεθνηκότων καὶ μετʼ ἐμοῦ·

verses.geez: ወየሀብክን ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ትርከባ ፡ ዕረፍተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አምታቲክን ፡ ወሰዐመቶን ፡ ወጸርኃ ፡ ወበከያ ።
verses.translation: The Lord grant you that ye may find rest each of you in the house of her husband: and she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

translations.lxx: The Lord grant you that ye may find rest each of you in the house of her husband: and she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
translations.kjv: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
translations.ron: Domnul să vă ajute, ca să vă găsiţi adăpost fiecare în casa bărbatului său!" Apoi le-a sărutat; iar ele, începând a se tângui şi a plânge,
translations.grk: Δῴη Κύριος ὑμῖν καὶ εὕρητε ἀνάπαυσιν ἑκάστη ἐν οἴκῳ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς· καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτάς· καὶ ἐπῇραν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔλαυσαν.

verses.geez: ወይቤላሃ ፡ ምስሌኪ ፡ ንገብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕዝብኪ ።
verses.translation: And they said to her, We will return with thee to thy people.

translations.lxx: And they said to her, We will return with thee to thy people.
translations.kjv: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.
translations.ron: Au zis: "Nu, ci ne vom întoarce împreună la poporul tău!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῇ, μετὰ σου ἐπιστρέφομεν εἰς τὸν λαόν σου.

verses.geez:
ወትቤሎን ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ እትዋ ፡ አዋልድየ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ትመጽኣ ፡ ምስሌየ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ ዘብየ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ከርሥየ ፡ እለ ፡ ያወስቡክን ።
verses.translation: And Noemin said, Return now, my daughters; and why do ye go with me? have I yet sons in my womb to be your husbands?

translations.lxx: And Noemin said, Return now, my daughters; and why do ye go with me? have I yet sons in my womb to be your husbands?
translations.kjv: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
translations.ron: Noemina însă a zis: "Întoarceţi-vă, fiicele mele, de ce să mergeţi voi cu mine? Au doară mai am eu feciori în pântecele meu care să vă poată fi bărbaţi?
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Νωεμὶν, ἐπιστράφητε δὴ θυγατέρες μου· καὶ ἱνατί πορεύεσθε μετʼ ἐμοῦ; μὴ ἔτι μοι υἱοὶ ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ μου, καὶ ἔσονται ὑμῖν εἰς ἄνδρας;

verses.geez: እትዋ ፡ እንከሰ ፡ አዋልድየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ረሣእኩ ፡ እምነ ፡ አውስቦ ፡ ዘእምወለድኩ ፡ ውሉደ ።
verses.translation: Turn now, my daughters, for I am too old to be married: for I said, Suppose I were married, and should bear sons;

translations.lxx: Turn now, my daughters, for I am too old to be married: for I said, Suppose I were married, and should bear sons;
translations.kjv: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;
translations.ron: Întoarceţi-vă, fiicele mele, întoarceri-vă, căci eu sunt prea bătrână ca să mă mai mărit. Şi chiar de v-aş spune că tot mai am nădejde şi chiar dacă la noapte aş avea bărbat şi apoi aş naşte fii,
translations.grk: Ἐπιστράφητε δὴ θυγατέρες μου, διότι γεγήρακα τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἀνδρί· ὅτι εἶπα, ὅτι ἐστί μοι ὑπόστασις τοῦ γενηθῆναί με ἀνδρὶ, καὶ τέξομαι υἱούς·

verses.geez:
ወትፀንሓሆሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ አመ ፡ ይልህቁ ፡ ወታጽንዓ ፡ ርእሰክን ፡ ወኢታውስባ፤አልቦ ፡ አዋልድየ ፡ እስመ ፡ መረረተኒ ፡
                  ነፍስየ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ እምኔክን ፡ እስመ ፡ ወፅአት ፡ እምኔየ ፡ እደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: would ye wait for them till they should be grown? or would ye refrain from being married for their sakes? Not so, my daughters; for I am grieved for you, that the hand of the Lord has gone forth against me.

translations.lxx: would ye wait for them till they should be grown? or would ye refrain from being married for their sakes? Not so, my daughters; for I am grieved for you, that the hand of the Lord has gone forth against me.
translations.kjv: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.
translations.ron: Aţi putea voi oare aştepta până vor creşte? Puteţi voi oare să întârziaţi să nu vă măritaţi? Nu, fiicele mele; mie îmi pare foarte rău de voi, căci mâna Domnului m-a apăsat".
translations.grk: Μὴ αὐτοὺς προσδέξεσθε ἕως οὗ ἁδρυνθώσιν; ἢ αὐτοῖς κατασχεθήσεσθε τοῦ μὴ γενέσθαι ἀνδρί; μὴ δὴ θυγατέρες μου, ὅτι ἐπικράνθη μοι ὑπὲρ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ἐξῆλθεν ἐν ἐμοὶ χεὶρ Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ወጸርኃ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ ወበከያ ፡ ወሰዐመታ ፡ ዖርፋ ፡ [ለ]ሐማታ ፡ ወተመይጠት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሕዝባ ፡ ወሩትሰ ፡ ተለወታ ።
verses.translation: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again; and Orpha kissed her mother-in-law and returned to her people; but Ruth followed her.

translations.lxx: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again; and Orpha kissed her mother-in-law and returned to her people; but Ruth followed her.
translations.kjv: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
translations.ron: Atunci ele din nou şi-au ridicat glasul şi au început a plânge. Apoi Orfa şi-a luat rămas bun de la soacra sa şi s-a întors la poporul său, iar Rut a rămas cu ea.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπῇραν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔκλαυσαν ἔτι· καὶ κατεφίλησεν Ὀρφὰ τὴν πενθερὰν αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν λαὸν αὐτῆς· Ῥοὺθ δὲ ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῇ.

verses.geez:
ወትቤላ ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ ለሩት ፡ ናሁ ፡ አተወት ፡ ካልእትኪ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሕዝባ ፡ ወኀበ ፡ አማልክቲሃ ፡ እትዊ ፡ አንቲኒ ፡
                  ምስለ ፡ ካልእትኪ ።
verses.translation: And Noemin said to Ruth, Behold, thy sister-in-law has returned to her people and to her gods; turn now thou also after thy sister-in-law.

translations.lxx: And Noemin said to Ruth, Behold, thy sister-in-law has returned to her people and to her gods; turn now thou also after thy sister-in-law.
translations.kjv: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Noemina către Rut: "Iată cumnata ta s-a întors la poporul său şi la dumnezeii săi. Întoarce-te şi tu după cumnata ta!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Νωεμῖν πρὸς Ῥοὺθ, ἰδοὺ ἀνέστρεψε σύννυμφός σου πρὸς λαὸν αὐτῆς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς θεοὺς αὐτῆς· ἐπιστράφηθι δὴ καὶ σὺ ὀπίσω τῆς συννύμφου σου.

verses.geez:
ወትቤላ ፡ ሩት ፡ ኢያብሐኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ እኅድጊ ፡ ወከመ ፡ እትመየጥ ፡ እምድኅሬኪ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሖርኪ ፡ አንቲ ፡ አሐውር ፡
                  ወኀበ ፡ ኀደርኪ ፡ አኀድር ፡ ሕዝብኪ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ወአምላክኪ ፡ አምላክየ ።
verses.translation: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following thee; for whithersoever thou goest, I will go, and wheresoever thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God.

translations.lxx: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following thee; for whithersoever thou goest, I will go, and wheresoever thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God.
translations.kjv: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
translations.ron: Iar Rut a zis: "Nu mă sili să te părăsesc şi să mă duc de la tine; căci unde te vei duce tu, acolo voi merge şi eu şi unde vei trăi tu, voi trăi şi eu; poporul tău va fi poporul meu şi Dumnezeul tău va fi Dumnezeul meu;
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὴ Ῥοῦθ, μὴ ἀπάντησαί μοι τοῦ καταλιπεῖν σε, ἢ ἀποστρέψαι ὄπισθέν σου, ὅτι σὺ ὅπου ἐὰν πορευθῇς, πορεύσομαι, καὶ οὗ ἐὰν αὐλισθῇς, αὐλισθήσομαι· ὁ λαός σου, λαός μου, καὶ ὁ Θεός σου, Θεός μου·

verses.geez:
ወበኀበ ፡ ሞትኪ ፡ እመውት ፡ ወህየ ፡ እትቀበር ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ለይረስየኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወከመዝ ፡ ለይኩን ፡ ከመ ፡
                  አልቦ ፡ ዘይፈልጠኒ ፡ እምኔኪ ፡ እንበለ ፡ ሞት ።
verses.translation: And wherever thou diest, I will die, and there will I be buried: the Lord do so to me, and more also, if I leave thee, for death only shall divide between me and thee.

translations.lxx: And wherever thou diest, I will die, and there will I be buried: the Lord do so to me, and more also, if I leave thee, for death only shall divide between me and thee.
translations.kjv: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.
translations.ron: Unde vei muri tu, voi muri şi eu şi voi fi îngropată acolo. Orice-mi va face Domnul, numai moartea mă va despărţi de tine!"
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗ ἐὰν ἀποθάνῃς, ἀποθανοῦμαι, κᾀκεῖ ταφήσομαι· τάδε ποιήσαι μοι Κύριος, καὶ τάδε προσθείη, ὅτι θάνατος διαστελεῖ ἀναμέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ርእየት ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ ከመ ፡ አጽንዐት ፡ ለሐዊር ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ኀደገት ፡ እንከ ፡ ብሂሎታ ።
verses.translation: And Noemin seeing that she was determined to go with her, ceased to speak to her any more.

translations.lxx: And Noemin seeing that she was determined to go with her, ceased to speak to her any more.
translations.kjv: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.
translations.ron: Văzând Noemina că este aşa de hotărâtă să meargă cu ea, a încetat de a o mai îndemna să se întoarcă.
translations.grk: Ἰδοῦσα δὲ Νωεμὶν ὅτι κραταιοῦται αὐτὴ τοῦ πορεύεσθαι μετʼ αὐτῆς, ἐκόπασε τοῦ λαλῆσαι πρὸς αὐτὴν ἔτι.

verses.geez:
ወሖራ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ እስከ ፡ በጽሓ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ልሔም ፡ ወደምፀት ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሀገር ፡ በእንቲአሃ ፡ ወይቤልዋ ፡ ሕያውትኑ
                  ፡ አንቲ ፡ ኖሔሚን ።
verses.translation: And they went both of them until they came to Bethleem: and it came to pass, when they arrived at Bethleem, that all the city rang with them, and they said, Is this Noemin?

translations.lxx: And they went both of them until they came to Bethleem: and it came to pass, when they arrived at Bethleem, that all the city rang with them, and they said, Is this Noemin?
translations.kjv: So they two went until they came to Bethlehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Bethlehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?
translations.ron: Şi au plecat amândouă şi au venit la Betleem. Iar dacă au sosit aici, s-a zvonit de ele în toată cetatea şi se zicea: "Oare aceasta este Noemina?"
translations.grk: Ἐπορεύθησαν δὲ ἀμφότεραι, ἕως τοῦ παραγενέσθαι αὐτὰς εἰς Βηθλεέμ· καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὰς εἰς Βηθλεὲμ, καὶ ἤχησε πᾶσα ἡ πόλις ἐπʼ αὐταῖς, καὶ εἶπον, εἰ αὕτη ἐστὶ Νωεμίν;

verses.geez: ወትቤሎን ፡ ኢትስምያኒ ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ ስምያኒ ፡ መራር ፡ እስመ ፡ መረርኩ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወብዙኀ ።
verses.translation: And she said to them, Nay, do not call me Noemin; call me ‘Bitter,’ for the Mighty One has dealt very bitterly with me.

translations.lxx: And she said to them, Nay, do not call me Noemin; call me ‘Bitter,’ for the Mighty One has dealt very bitterly with me.
translations.kjv: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
translations.ron: Iar ea zicea: "Nu mă mai numiţi Noemina, ci numiţi-mă Mara, pentru că amărăciune mare mi-a trimis Atotţiitorul.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε πρὸς αὐτὰς, μὴ δὴ καλεῖτέ με Νωεμίν· καλέσατέ με πικρὰν, ὅτι ἐπικράνθη ἐν ἐμοὶ ὁ ἱκανὸς σφόδρα.

verses.geez:
አንሰ ፡ ምልእትየ ፡ ሖርኩ ፡ ወዕራቅየ ፡ አግብአኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለምንት ፡ ትብላኒ ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ እንዘ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ አኅሰረኒ ፡ ወፈድፋደ ፡ አሕመመኒ ።
verses.translation: I went out full, and the Lord has brought me back empty: and why call ye me Noemin, whereas the Lord has humbled me, and the Mighty One has afflicted me?

translations.lxx: I went out full, and the Lord has brought me back empty: and why call ye me Noemin, whereas the Lord has humbled me, and the Mighty One has afflicted me?
translations.kjv: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
translations.ron: Îndestulată am ieşit eu de aici, iar Domnul m-a întors cu mâinile goale. La ce să mă mai numiţi Noemina, când Domnul m-a făcut să sufăr şi Atotţiitorul mi-a trimis necaz?"
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ πλήρης ἐπορεύθην, καὶ κενὴν ἀπέστρεψέ με ὁ Κύριος· καὶ ἱνατί καλεῖτέ με Νωεμὶν, καὶ Κύριος ἐταπείνωσέ με, καὶ ὁ ἱκανὸς ἐκάκωσέ με;

verses.geez:
ወገብአት ፡ ኖሔሚን ፡ ወሩት ፡ መርዓታ ፡ ሞአባዊት ፡ ወአተዋ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሐቅለ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ወበጽሓ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡
                  ልሔም ፡ አመ ፡ ቀዳሜ ፡ ማእረረ ፡ ስገም ።
verses.translation: So Noemin and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, returned from the country of Moab; and they came to Bethleem in the beginning of barley harvest.

translations.lxx: So Noemin and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, returned from the country of Moab; and they came to Bethleem in the beginning of barley harvest.
translations.kjv: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
translations.ron: Aşa s-a întors Noemina cu nora sa Rut moabiteanca, venind din şesul Moabiţilor şi au intrat în Betleem pe la începutul secerişului orzului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψε Νωεμὶν καὶ Ῥοὺθ ἡ Μωαβίτις ἡ νύμφη αὐτῆς ἐπιστρέφουσαι ἐξ ἀγροῦ Μωάβ· αὗται δὲ παρεγενήθησαν εἰς Βηθλεὲμ ἐν ἀρχῇ θερισμοῦ κριθῶν.
